<!-- R / reticulate variant of Dashboard.qmd -- see new_analysis_r.qmd's AI
     instructions block for the tested reticulate setup/conversion pattern;
     it's not repeated in full here. Ask Posit Assistant to write the code
     for each row below using dplyr/ggplot2, then run the chunk it inserts. -->

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false

library(reticulate)
library(dplyr)

venv_python <- file.path(getwd(), ".venv", "bin", "python")
if (!file.exists(venv_python)) {
  stop(
    "No .venv found at ", venv_python, ". Create it first: python3.14 -m venv .venv, ",
    "then run `python scripts/check_packages.py` to install the required packages into it."
  )
}
use_python(venv_python, required = TRUE)

# import_from_path(), not sys.path manipulation -- see new_analysis_r.qmd's
# AI instructions block for why.
dh <- import_from_path("databricks_helpers", path = file.path(getwd(), "scripts"))

df_py <- dh$load_waiting_list()
RTT_THRESHOLD <- dh$RTT_THRESHOLD
df <- as.data.frame(py_to_r(df_py$to_dict(as_series = FALSE)), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```
